title: Project Manager
summary: Lead and manage infrastructure projects from inception to completion, ensuring quality, safety, and timely delivery.
description: We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee our infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing large-scale construction projects, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders.
responsibilities: Plan, execute, and finalize projects according to strict deadlines and within budget
Coordinate with clients, contractors, and internal teams to ensure project success
Develop project scopes and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders
Ensure resource availability and allocation throughout the project lifecycle
Monitor and report on project progress to senior management
Implement and manage project changes and interventions to achieve project outputs
Ensure compliance with safety regulations and quality standards
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related field
5+ years of experience in project management within the construction industry
PMP certification preferred
Strong understanding of infrastructure construction methodologies
Excellent communication and leadership skills
Proficiency in project management software (MS Project, Primavera)
Knowledge of safety regulations and quality control procedures

title: Civil Engineer
summary: Design and supervise infrastructure projects including roads, highways, and urban development works.
description: NIA Infra Project is looking for a skilled Civil Engineer to join our engineering team. You will be responsible for designing, planning, and overseeing construction projects while ensuring all works meet technical specifications and safety standards.
responsibilities: Prepare detailed designs and drawings for infrastructure projects
Conduct site surveys and feasibility studies
Supervise construction activities to ensure compliance with design specifications
Prepare technical reports and project documentation
Collaborate with architects, contractors, and other engineers
Perform quantity surveys and cost estimation
Ensure adherence to environmental and safety regulations
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering
3+ years of experience in infrastructure or road construction
Proficiency in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and other design software
Strong knowledge of construction materials and methods
Understanding of relevant codes and standards
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Valid professional engineering license preferred

title: Site Supervisor
summary: Supervise daily construction activities, manage work crews, and ensure project milestones are achieved safely and efficiently.
description: We are hiring an experienced Site Supervisor to oversee day-to-day operations at our construction sites. The successful candidate will ensure that all work is carried out according to plans, specifications, and safety standards while maintaining productivity.
responsibilities: Supervise and coordinate daily construction activities on site
Manage and motivate construction crews to achieve project targets
Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards
Monitor material usage and manage inventory on site
Prepare daily progress reports and documentation
Coordinate with project managers and engineers on technical matters
Conduct safety briefings and enforce PPE compliance
requirements: Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Technology
4+ years of supervisory experience in road or infrastructure construction
Strong knowledge of construction equipment and techniques
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings
Excellent leadership and communication skills
First aid and safety certification preferred
Ability to work in demanding outdoor conditions

title: Heavy Equipment Operator
summary: Operate heavy machinery including excavators, bulldozers, graders, and rollers for infrastructure construction projects.
description: NIA Infra Project is seeking skilled Heavy Equipment Operators to join our fleet operations team. You will operate various types of heavy machinery used in road construction and infrastructure development projects.
responsibilities: Operate heavy equipment including excavators, bulldozers, graders, and rollers
Perform daily equipment inspections and basic maintenance
Follow site plans and instructions from supervisors
Ensure safe operation of equipment at all times
Report any equipment malfunctions or safety hazards
Maintain accurate logs of equipment usage and fuel consumption
Assist with loading and unloading materials as needed
requirements: Valid heavy equipment operator certification/license
3+ years of experience operating construction machinery
Experience with road construction equipment preferred
Knowledge of equipment maintenance and safety procedures
Ability to work in various weather conditions
Physical fitness for demanding work environment
Clean driving record
